tagline: End-to-end commercial biopharmaceutical company dedicated to manufacturing specialty biologics
hero_kpi_rationale: Primary growth driver for the company, benefiting from FDA approval in April 2025 of the innovative yield enhancement process that increases production by 20% or more from the same volume of source plasma

kpis.name: ASCENIV Revenue
kpis.description: Revenue from ASCENIV, plasma-derived IVIG for treatment of Primary Immunodeficiency in adults and adolescents, with commercial sales commenced October 2019
kpis.signal: Substantial revenue growth driven by expanded prescriber and patient base

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Net income of the company on GAAP basis
kpis.description: Net income on GAAP basis for fiscal year ended December 31, 2024, representing first profitability milestone in company history
kpis.signal: First net income achievement in company history achieved in fiscal year 2024, continued into 2025

kpis.name: Operating Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash flow generated from operating activities
kpis.description: Positive cash flow from operations of $118.7 million for fiscal year 2024, continued throughout fiscal year 2025
kpis.signal: Positive cash flow from operations achieved and sustained

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.description: Gross margin expected to expand in fiscal 2026 with first full year of yield-enhanced production
kpis.signal: Anticipated continued margin expansion in fiscal 2026 from yield enhancement process

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Annual consolidated revenue, value extracted from yfinance.income_stmt over the last four reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Revenue of €0.51 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €0.62 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €0.08 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Cash & Equivalents
kpis.description: Cash & equivalents extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Cash & equivalents of €0.09 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: ASCENIV Production Yield Enhancement
kpis.explanation: Production yield increase from innovative yield enhancement process
kpis.description: Innovative yield enhancement production process approved by FDA in April 2025 increases ASCENIV and BIVIGAM production yields by 20% or more from same starting source plasma volume
kpis.signal: FDA approval of Prior Approval Supplement in April 2025 enabling 20% or more yield increase

kpis.name: Plasma Collection Facilities
kpis.explanation: Number of FDA-licensed source plasma collection centers operated
kpis.description: ADMA BioCenters operates plasma collection centers, reduced from 8 to 7 following December 2025 divestiture as part of shift to capital-efficient supply model
kpis.signal: Strategic divestiture of 3 centers completed with long-term plasma supply agreements executed

risks.title: Customer Concentration
risks.summary: Loss of key customers could have a negative impact on revenues and financial position of the company.
risks.score_rationale: Historically, a few customers have represented a significant portion of revenues and total accounts receivable. Loss of any major customer could have a material adverse effect on business, operating results and financial condition. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Third-Party Dependence
risks.summary: Dependence on third parties for production and delivery of finished products could result in delays or interruptions.
risks.score_rationale: Reliance on third parties for supply of services and raw materials essential to production could result in delays or interruptions in delivery of finished products. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Regulatory Risks
risks.summary: Regulatory risks, including inspections and FDA actions, could have a negative impact on the company.
risks.score_rationale: Regulatory inspections and FDA actions could have a negative impact on the company, particularly in case of non-compliance with regulatory requirements. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.summary: Cybersecurity threats could have a negative impact on company reputation and operations.
risks.score_rationale: Cyberattacks and security breaches could compromise confidential information and damage reputation. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Product Quality
risks.summary: Product quality issues could have a negative impact on company reputation and operations.
risks.score_rationale: Product quality issues could result in recalls, fines and loss of customer confidence. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Pandemic or Epidemic
risks.summary: A pandemic or epidemic could have a negative impact on the company due to supply chain and production disruptions.
risks.score_rationale: A pandemic or epidemic could have a negative impact on the company due to supply chain and production disruptions. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Financial Risks
risks.summary: Financial risks, particularly ability to maintain profitability, could have a negative impact on company financial position.
risks.score_rationale: Ability to maintain profitability and generate positive cash flows is uncertain, and the company may need additional financing to support operations. (default score, to be refined)

ai_positioning.summary: ADMA Biologics uses artificial intelligence in its supply chain and production operations. The company has implemented a strategy to improve the efficiency of its manufacturing capacity, enhance yields, strengthen supply chain robustness, and improve in-house fill and finish capabilities.
evidence: our use of AI in our supply chain and production operations
